program.name: Hoi An
program.description: Two nights by the old town, with a walking tour and a basket boat ride through the coconut palms.

1: Arrival at Da Nang and transfer to your hotel
Check in near My Khe beach
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Dragon Bridge after dark
2: Breakfast, then the cable car up to Ba Na
The bridge held up by two stone hands
The French village and the gardens at the top
Back down to Da Nang in the evening
3: Breakfast and check out, then south to Hoi An
Check in at your garden hotel
A walk through the old town with a guide
The Japanese bridge and the merchant houses
4: Breakfast, then out to Cam Thanh
A basket boat spun through the water palms
The creeks and the rowers at work
Afternoon free among the lantern lanes
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Da Nang airport for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Five days on one stretch of coast. No flights inside the trip, no packing every morning.
expert.tip: Stay in Hoi An rather than commuting from Da Nang. The old town after the day trippers leave is the best part of it.

summary: A five day break on the central coast: two nights in Da Nang with a full day at Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then two by the old town in Hoi An with a walking tour and a basket boat ride through the Cam Thanh coconut palms.
included: Included: 4 nights with breakfast and dinner daily; private transfers throughout; a full day at Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge; a Hoi An walking tour; a half day Cam Thanh basket boat trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
